audit_items.proof_trace: The system enforces the oracle price assumption on all borrow-safety paths via `get_price_with_check` (user.move:42-59), which validates both EMA and spot prices for freshness, asserts their relative deviation is within the per-asset `ema_spot_tolerance`, and returns the EMA price (time-weighted, flash-loan-resistant). The liquidation path intentionally uses `get_price` (EMA-only, no divergence check) so liquidations remain possible during market stress — a deliberate design decision. The flash-loan `get_price` call (flash_loan.move:165) is used only for referral-tracking, not financial accounting. Additional Pyth-adapter defenses (30-second staleness check, confidence-interval check, registered-feed verification) prevent injection of stale or fabricated prices.
